image_description: A full suit of polished steel plate armor standing on a display stand in an indoor setting. The armor includes a breastplate, pauldrons (shoulder guards), faulds (waist armor), gauntlets, and greaves (leg armor). The surface is highly reflective, showing distorted reflections of the room. To the left and right foreground are dark, pointed shield-like objects or helmet visors. In the background, there is a wooden cabinet and a framed picture or mirror.
